{{Top|leg}}
A '''phased-plasma blaster cannon''' was a large and powerful energy weapon. It was capable of leaving large, man-sized craters when fired. The [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Locux Hyen]] carried a phased-plasma [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].
